modesNote: every Tracy WordPress theme (tracy-base and the wp-* overlays that extend this contract) has a light/dark switch ([data-tracy-theme-toggle] in parts/header.html; assets/js/<theme>-dark.js sets data-theme light|dark on html, none for auto): styles.css writes the system's own side under the theme's matching mode and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs, src/sides.mjs), the dark side again under prefers-color-scheme: dark for auto, and does not hide the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2)
accentTextNote: 16/10/2026: the outline and call-to-action buttons' accent text (accentText, !important at :root x6) stops at the scene (ink) bands of the landing pages (every story chapter under a centered hero, the media-left one under a split hero; tracy-base-parity-pages.css), where the theme paints the ghost action with --ds-c-on-ink: under Mailchimp's light side the accent text read 3.30:1 on the ink on Home variant and Home variation ("Talk through a project", "See the website toolkit"). The stop is wrapped in :where() so it adds no specificity: the featured plan's followRule (accent-on!) must still outrank it.
featuredCardNote: 15/10/2026: the featured plan is marked by the template, on /pricing with a ring (.tracy-plan.is-hot: 0 0 0 1px muted over the pattern's 0 0 0 2px accent) and on the home plans with a 2px accent border (the middle plan). The card rule (the system's card shadow) replaced the ring, so under Mailchimp Studio looked like the other plans, light and dark; the home border took Mailchimp's yellow, 1.2:1 on the page. Under a system the ring is 2px in the system's accent read 3:1 on the page (else its readable accent text) before the card shadow, and the home border takes that colour (tokens56.mjs featuredCardRules). The template default writes nothing
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every theme rule (deepest measured (0,5,1)), below a block's own inline style, so an editor's per-block choice still wins.
